orders.text:
Stay Application No. 10696 of 2012 
In 
WPMS No. 2462 of 2016 
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. Siddhartha Singh and Mr. P.S. 
Bisht, Advocates for the petitioner. 
Mr. Sayed Nadim, Advocate for 
respondent nos. 1 & 2. 
Mr. R.C. Arya, Standing Counsel 
for State of Uttarakhand. 
Heard. 
Admit. 
Issue notice to respondent nos. 1 
& 2, returnable at an early date, by 
registered post, acknowledgement due. 
List for orders after service report 
is received. 
Heard learned counsel for the 
parties and also perused the judgment 
of the courts below. 
Considering the submissions of the 
learned counsel for the parties, it is 
directed that till the next date of listing, 
the respondent nos. 1 & 2 shall not 
create any third party interest over the 
property in dispute. 
Stay application is disposed of. 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) 
 05.09.2016
 Navin

Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
(Via Video Conferencing) 
Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. Anurag Bisaria, Standing Counsel for the 
State of Uttarakhand. 
Mr. Sudhir Kumar, Advocate for respondent 
nos. 1 and 2 
A request has been made by the learned 
counsel for the respondent for seeking adjournment. 
The same is opposed by the learned counsel 
for the petitioner. 
Since, the matter pertains to a Suit of 1991, 
however, in the interest of justice, considering the 
request made by the learned counsel for the 
respondent, the writ petition is adjourned and 
directed to be listed in the week commencing 
17.08.2020, with an understanding that no further 
adjournment would be granted, subject to that there 
are, if any, untoward circumstances prevailing. 
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 
 07.08.2020 
Pooja
